prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my statement without my name on it, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in Pasadena, Texas, on a multi-lane road, heading toward the freeway entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to move into the right lane because I needed to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror and it looked clear, so I signaled and started to move over.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle in the lane I was moving into came up alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I felt a jolt and heard metal scraping. I pulled to the shoulder right after.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?
A: Not clearly. It was in my blind spot, I think. I didn't see it until it was already there.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes, my lower back. It tightened up right away and by the next morning it was hard to bend or stand for long periods.
Q: Have you sought medical care?
A: I've been to a clinic and I'm still doing physical therapy. The doctor said it looks like a muscle strain, and I'm supposed to keep going to appointments.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Only that I'm willing to share my photos from the scene and any documents the clinic has given me.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
